_OaksLabHomePCUpdatedText:
text "PROF.OAK: By the"
	line "way, your home PC"
	cont "has been upgraded!"
	para "You can deposit"
	line "and withdraw"
	cont "#MON!"
	done
FlyHouseExplanationWithSpecialFlyTips:
text "HM02 is FLY!"
	line "It is a very"
	cont "useful move!"
	para "Use it wisely!"
	para "On the Fly Map,"
	line "press UP/DOWN to"
	cont "choose a town."
	para "Press A to fly"
	line "to your choice!"
	para "Press LEFT/RIGHT"
	line "to switch between"
	cont "visited special"
	cont "locations."
	done
FishingGuruOldRodRepeatText:
text "Ah..."
	line "<PLAYER>!"
	para "How's the fishing"
	line "going lately?"
	para "Here is a fishing"
	line "tip for you!"
	para "First, use a Rod"
	line "from your Bag."
	para "Then stand by the"
	line "water and face it."
	para "Press SELECT to"
	line "fish right away!"
	para "SELECT uses the"
	line "last chosen rod."
	para "To change rods,"
	line "use another one"
	cont "from your Bag."
	para "If you are not"
	line "facing the water,"
	cont "SELECT still lets"
	cont "you ride a Bike."
	done

SurfFishingRepeatText:
text "HM03 is SURF!"
	para "With it, you can"
	line "ride a #MON"
	cont "across the water!"
	para "It is an HM, so"
	line "use it as often"
	cont "as you like."
	para "It never vanishes!"
	para "You are so lucky"
	line "to get this prize!"
	para "You can fish while"
	line "surfing, too!"
	para "Open your Bag"
	line "on the water."
	para "Use the Rod you"
	line "want to use."
	para "Then press SELECT"
	line "to use it again."
	para "To change rods,"
	line "return to your Bag"
	cont "and choose another"
